_comment: Cross-language conformance vector for the canonical pack hash. The hash is computed over the relPath-keyed file map: entries sorted by relPath (native byte order), each emitted as `<relPath>\n<content>\n`, concatenated, SHA-256, lowercase hex. Empty map => "". Asserted by BundleHasherTest/BundleHashConformanceTest (plugin, Kotlin) AND hashUtils.test.ts (backend, TS). If you change the hash algorithm you MUST update both implementations and regenerate expectedHash. See CLAUDE.md § Invariants critiques. ADDITIONALLY: any relPath whose FIRST SEGMENT starts with `.artisan` (e.g. `.artisan-sync.yaml`, `.artisan/editor.yaml`) is METADATA — excluded from the hash by BOTH implementations; the entries below must not change expectedHash.
